items.title: The pushforward along a proper morphism commutes with direct sums for coefficients in Z/nZ
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the derived pushforward along a proper morphism, with coefficients in Z/nZ, commutes with direct sums (statement lines 20140-20151). The proof (proof lines 20153-20161) reduces to a quasi-compact base, bounds the fibre dimension by the finite type input, applies the proper dimension bound to get finite cohomological dimension, and then the commutation lemma. H2: two reductions plus one application.
